tags.gist: Says reassessment is triggered by whether the system still does its work, checked each morning at a top level, since something can always break.
From running AI that checks an AI call center, says the checker should come from another company and model, and a person should still review.
Says a small practice has nobody to watch the model, must guard its sensitive data, and needs a daily check, not quarterly reports.
Says the model changes when its developer decides; when it does, rerun the checks and tell the practice the same day.
